verdict.rationale: The probe found no llms.txt at developer.atlassian.com (HTTP 404), and nothing in the pack documents agent-oriented docs such as LLM-friendly markdown docs or an agent docs index. The OpenAPI spec and the MCP server belong to separate stories (machine-readable API spec, MCP server) and do not count as agent-oriented documentation here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
